48: Alfalfa - Type of seed it is, to (make) herb (for) farm animals, and at the end of 30 days it finishes (fully growing) and (a person) uproots it, and plant another in (its) place. And within (those) 30 days (it would be ready to) cut it three times (a month for use as continious feed).
To cut it (the fruit) [while tender] (and again) cut it and eat - And this is not food of the whole fruit (not mature).
